text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tenders for RFT-56-Roof Replacement at Member and Guest Services Building project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of Request for Tenders RFT-17 - Roof Replacement at Member and Guest Services Building to Provincial Industrial Roofing and Sheet Metal Co. Ltd., in the amount of $1,119,950.00, excluding Harmonized Sales Tax.
